ownerDirective.speaker: Governor
ownerDirective.exactText: i'm the governmor of the minecraft world and I've come to cut red tape
ownerDirective.interpretation: The Governor delegates this finite Ravensreach passive-rail foundation, retaining every hard-safety control.

mvpBoundary.included: Only the exact two isolated Ravensreach tube liners and passive rail slices.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: No public route, guideway connection, vehicle, power, signal, platform opening, or passenger service is authorized.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Canonical state binding, exact inversion, tube isolation, and independent QA are mandatory.
Fresh immutable source and exact preflight are mandatory immediately before mutation.
Forward and reverse parser checks are strict-noop.
Exact block-entity and fresh live-entity clearance are mandatory.
Execution is journaled and failure rolls back exactly in reverse order.
Fresh post capture, rollback-poststate proof, and independent post QA precede acceptance.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: Failure blocks only this exact passive rail foundation.
